module: Auxiliary differential-braking steering controller (tracked machines or skid-steer): depending on the steering wheel input `steering_input`, it brakes the left wheel (wheel turned left) or the right wheel (wheel turned right) by adding braking torque to the wheel rotators' `desiredBrakingTorque`, without exceeding their `brakeTorque`.
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `steeringPlay` (steering wheel dead zone, 0..1, default 0), `leftBrakeName` ("brake_L"), `rightBrakeName` ("brake_R"): names of rotators in `wheels.wheelRotators`, `maxSteeringBrakeTorque` (optional limit, capped by the wheel's brakeTorque).
The effect is attenuated at very low speed: linear coefficient from 0 to 1 for `wheelspeed` from 0 to 0.2 m/s.
If one of the two wheels cannot be found, init logs an error and replaces updateGFX and updateWheelsIntermediate with `nop` (the controller is inert).

updateWheelsIntermediate.desc: Intermediate physics step: adds the steering braking torque (brake × max torque) to each wheel's requested torque, capped at its brakeTorque.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: computes the left/right braking level from `steering_input` and speed.

init.desc: Finds the left/right wheels, computes the maximum steering braking torques.
